entries.en: V, got a gig for you – one I'd rather not have. Bryce Stone, preacher on TV – his son was brutally murdered.
entries.ro: V, am un gig pentru tine – unul pe care aș prefera să nu-l am. Bryce Stone, predicator la TV – fiul lui a fost ucis brutal.

entries.en: Only way to catch this child killer is to get your hands on the original BD that recorded the whole thing.
entries.ro: Singura cale să-l prindem pe ucigașul ăsta de copii e să pui mâna pe BD-ul original care a filmat tot.

entries.en: Yeah, you heard that right, unfortunately. More info on the whole thing attached.
entries.ro: Da, ai auzit bine, din păcate. Mai multe detalii sunt atașate.
